_doc: Per-pool count of distinct arbitrage signers, from the arb-lab patterns scan of w5h-p1..p15 (tools/analysis/patterns/scan.py on Cherry, 2026-10-03). bots = the maximum over segments of the number of distinct arb signers that touched the pool in one segment (tools/analysis/patterns/analyze.py:32 POOLBOTS). `crowded` is the PATTERNS.md item 10 set (bots >= 150), the input of data/crowded-pools.json (PLAN WP-00). `bins` reproduces the PATTERNS.md crowding table (pool-attempts: an attempt counts once per pool it touched). Rebuild: tools/capture-fixtures.py --pool-bots <dir of scan-w5h-p*.json>.
